component.title: MasterDetail
component.purpose: MasterDetail preserves selection, scroll position, and focus order while transforming adjacency into a compact drill-in.

states.description: A selected record is available beside the collection.
The workspace frame remains stable while records load.
The collection explains its empty state without fabricating detail.
Partial detail is named without hiding known context.
Request failure remains visible inside the workspace.

claims.statement: Compact selection drills into detail while preserving a return path to the collection.
Loading, empty, partial, and request-error states retain the same workspace hierarchy.
